RoTorrent - source code availability (GNU GPL v2 or later)
=========================================================

RoTorrent is free software released under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or (at your option) any
later version. It is based on the qBittorrent project (https://github.com/qbittorrent/qBittorrent).

You are entitled to the complete corresponding source code of the exact version you received.

  - This release archive is accompanied by RoTorrent-@VERSION@-source.zip, which contains that source code and
    the scripts used to build it.
  - It is also published at @SOURCE_URL@
  - If you received only the binary, you may request the source code at the address above. This offer is valid for
    at least three years after the date of this release, as the GPL requires for binary distributions.

The upstream qBittorrent code RoTorrent is derived from is recorded in docs/UPSTREAM.md (commit, date, list of
removed and changed parts). All original copyright notices are kept in the source files.
